title: SB2790 (2026 Regular): Responsible Firearm Purchasing Act; enact.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Mississippi) (gun-policy Stage 5, Mississippi); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Mississippi text (Introduced; official copy, https://billstatus.ls.state.ms.us/documents/2026/html/SB/2700-2799/SB2790IN.htm)
provenance.note: Introduced text. Sections 5 and 6 as printed refer to 'Section 2' (the definitions) and 'Section 2 or 3', apparently meaning Section 3; quoted as printed. 'Minor' is defined nowhere in the text read. No passage vote on record.

operative_text:
Section 3 (new section): It shall be unlawful for a minor in this state to purchase a firearm, handgun, ammunition or armor piercing ammunition. It shall be unlawful to sell a minor in this state a firearm, handgun, ammunition or armor piercing ammunition.
Section 4 (new section): The purchase of a firearm, handgun, ammunition or armor piercing ammunition shall comply with all standards as provided by federal and state law.
Section 5 (new section): A minor who violates Section 2 of this act shall be guilty of a misdemeanor. Upon adjudication, the minor shall be fined no more than Two Hundred Dollars ($200.00) or subject to a term of imprisonment no longer than thirty (30) days, or both.
Section 6 (new section): A person who is twenty-one (21) years old or older and violates Section 2 or 3 of this act shall be guilty of a felony. Upon conviction, the defendant shall be fined no more than Two Thousand Dollars ($2,000.00) or subject to a term of imprisonment of no longer than two (2) years in the custody of the Department of Corrections, or both.
